name: omarchy-docket
description: Docket widget for the Omarchy bar - node is used ONLY to run the offline unit suite; the shipped plugin requires no node runtime

scripts.test:race: for run in 1 2 3; do node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/*.test.js || exit; done
scripts.audit: audit-harness verify && audit-harness audit . --deep && audit-harness scan .
